title: 社区参与与志愿服务 · 100 句
description: 志愿报名、接待、物资、活动组织、不同参与需要、边界、邻里事务与筹款。

items.zh: 这个岗位需要固定时间参加吗？
items.en: Does this role require regular attendance?
answers: Does this role require regular attendance?

items.zh: 我能帮忙，但每次时间有限。
items.en: I can help, but my time is limited.
answers: I can help, but my time is limited.

items.zh: 报名表没有列出年龄要求。
items.en: The form omits the age requirement.
answers: The form omits the age requirement.

items.zh: 活动是否提供必要培训？
items.en: Is training provided for this activity?
answers: Is training provided for this activity?

items.zh: 我想了解实际承担的任务。
items.en: I want to understand the practical duties.
answers: I want to understand the practical duties.

items.zh: 志愿者需要提前登记。
items.en: Volunteers need to register beforehand.
answers: Volunteers need to register beforehand.

items.zh: 我不方便搬运重物。
items.en: I cannot comfortably handle heavy loads.
answers: I cannot comfortably handle heavy loads.
I can't comfortably handle heavy loads.

items.zh: 我可以协助翻译文字。
items.en: I can help translate written material.
answers: I can help translate written material.

items.zh: 有没有适合初次参加者的安排？
items.en: Are there arrangements for first-time volunteers?
answers: Are there arrangements for first-time volunteers?

items.zh: 我们应明确双方的期待。
items.en: We should clarify expectations on both sides.
answers: We should clarify expectations on both sides.

items.zh: 入口需要有人引导。
items.en: Someone needs to guide people at the entrance.
answers: Someone needs to guide people at the entrance.

items.zh: 请先确认访客要去哪里。
items.en: First check where the visitor needs to go.
answers: First check where the visitor needs to go.

items.zh: 这份地图标出了无障碍通道。
items.en: This map marks the accessible route.
answers: This map marks the accessible route.

items.zh: 等候区在门的右边。
items.en: The waiting area is to the right of the door.
answers: The waiting area is to the right of the door.

items.zh: 我们会按到达顺序登记。
items.en: We register people in order of arrival.
answers: We register people in order of arrival.

items.zh: 我找不到你的姓名标签。
items.en: I cannot find your name badge.
answers: I cannot find your name badge.
I can't find your name badge.

items.zh: 请不要堵住主要出口。
items.en: Please keep the main exit clear.
answers: Please keep the main exit clear.

items.zh: 需要口译的人可以到这里咨询。
items.en: Anyone needing an interpreter can ask here.
answers: Anyone needing an interpreter can ask here.

items.zh: 我会带你去登记处。
items.en: I will take you to registration.
answers: I will take you to registration.

items.zh: 今天的安排有所调整。
items.en: Today's arrangements have changed.
answers: Today's arrangements have changed.

items.zh: 捐赠品需要按用途分类。
items.en: Donations need sorting by purpose.
answers: Donations need sorting by purpose.

items.zh: 这批物资缺少数量标签。
items.en: This batch lacks quantity labels.
answers: This batch lacks quantity labels.

items.zh: 先发放最急需的用品。
items.en: Distribute the most urgently needed supplies first.
answers: Distribute the most urgently needed supplies first.

items.zh: 我们需要保存领用记录。
items.en: We need records of items issued.
answers: We need records of items issued.

items.zh: 破损物品应单独放置。
items.en: Damaged items should be set aside.
answers: Damaged items should be set aside.

items.zh: 这个箱子上没有内容说明。
items.en: This box has no contents label.
answers: This box has no contents label.

items.zh: 食品捐赠有专门的接收规定。
items.en: Food donations have specific acceptance rules.
answers: Food donations have specific acceptance rules.

items.zh: 我负责清点剩余库存。
items.en: I am responsible for the remaining stock count.
answers: I am responsible for the remaining stock count.

items.zh: 运输需要考虑体积，不只是重量。
items.en: Transport planning needs volume as well as weight.
answers: Transport planning needs volume as well as weight.

items.zh: 我们不能承诺尚未收到的物资。
items.en: We cannot promise supplies not yet received.
answers: We cannot promise supplies not yet received.
We can't promise supplies not yet received.

items.zh: 场地容量限制了参加人数。
items.en: The venue capacity limits attendance.
answers: The venue capacity limits attendance.

items.zh: 我们需要一份雨天备用安排。
items.en: We need a wet-weather alternative.
answers: We need a wet-weather alternative.

items.zh: 活动说明要使用清楚的语言。
items.en: The instructions need plain language.
answers: The instructions need plain language.

items.zh: 儿童必须由指定成人陪同。
items.en: Children must have a designated adult accompanying them.
answers: Children must have a designated adult accompanying them.

items.zh: 报名人数超过了预期。
items.en: Registrations exceeded expectations.
answers: Registrations exceeded expectations.

items.zh: 我们能否增加一场说明会？
items.en: Could we add an information session?
answers: Could we add an information session?

items.zh: 音响设备需要提前测试。
items.en: The sound equipment needs an advance check.
answers: The sound equipment needs an advance check.

items.zh: 结束后留出清理时间。
items.en: Allow time for clearing up afterwards.
answers: Allow time for clearing up afterwards.

items.zh: 活动不应阻碍附近居民通行。
items.en: The event should not block residents' access.
answers: The event should not block residents' access.
The event shouldn't block residents' access.

items.zh: 我们想听听没有参加者的意见。
items.en: We want feedback from non-participants too.
answers: We want feedback from non-participants too.

items.zh: 这份材料有大字版吗？
items.en: Is a large-print version available?
answers: Is a large-print version available?

items.zh: 讲解速度需要让大家跟上。
items.en: The explanation needs a pace everyone can follow.
answers: The explanation needs a pace everyone can follow.

items.zh: 我们提供安静的休息角落。
items.en: We provide a quiet place to pause.
answers: We provide a quiet place to pause.

items.zh: 不要假设所有人都会上网。
items.en: Do not assume everyone uses the internet.
answers: Do not assume everyone uses the internet.
Don't assume everyone uses the internet.

items.zh: 可以用不同方式提交意见。
items.en: Feedback can be submitted in different ways.
answers: Feedback can be submitted in different ways.

items.zh: 椅子之间要留出轮椅空间。
items.en: Leave wheelchair space between the chairs.
answers: Leave wheelchair space between the chairs.

items.zh: 图片应配上文字说明。
items.en: Images should have written descriptions.
answers: Images should have written descriptions.

items.zh: 我们需要了解实际障碍是什么。
items.en: We need to understand the actual barrier.
answers: We need to understand the actual barrier.

items.zh: 提供帮助之前，先问对方是否需要。
items.en: Ask whether help is wanted before stepping in.
answers: Ask whether help is wanted before stepping in.
items.notes: step in：介入帮忙；避免把主动介入视为理所当然。

items.zh: 尊重个人选择也是支持的一部分。
items.en: Respecting choice is part of support.
answers: Respecting choice is part of support.

items.zh: 每个班次需要一位联系人。
items.en: Each shift needs a contact person.
answers: Each shift needs a contact person.

items.zh: 我会把重要情况交给下一班。
items.en: I will pass key information to the next shift.
answers: I will pass key information to the next shift.

items.zh: 任务变化后应更新名单。
items.en: Update the roster when duties change.
answers: Update the roster when duties change.

items.zh: 我们需要防止两个人重复处理。
items.en: We need to prevent duplicate effort.
answers: We need to prevent duplicate effort.

items.zh: 请说明你已经完成了什么。
items.en: Please state what you have completed.
answers: Please state what you have completed.

items.zh: 我现在需要另一位志愿者协助。
items.en: I need another volunteer's assistance now.
answers: I need another volunteer's assistance now.

items.zh: 不要把个人号码公开张贴。
items.en: Do not post personal numbers publicly.
answers: Do not post personal numbers publicly.
Don't post personal numbers publicly.

items.zh: 我们用统一渠道沟通变更。
items.en: We use one channel for changes.
answers: We use one channel for changes.

items.zh: 遇到无法解决的问题要升级处理。
items.en: Escalate issues you cannot resolve.
answers: Escalate issues you cannot resolve.
Escalate issues you can't resolve.

items.zh: 我可以接替最后半小时。
items.en: I can cover the final half hour.
answers: I can cover the final half hour.

items.zh: 受助者可以拒绝拍照。
items.en: Recipients may refuse to be photographed.
answers: Recipients may refuse to be photographed.

items.zh: 个人故事不能未经同意传播。
items.en: Personal stories must not circulate without consent.
answers: Personal stories must not circulate without consent.
Personal stories mustn't circulate without consent.

items.zh: 我们不应承诺超出自身能力范围的帮助。
items.en: We should not promise help beyond our competence.
answers: We should not promise help beyond our competence.
We shouldn't promise help beyond our competence.
items.notes: beyond our competence：超出能力范围。

items.zh: 尊严不应以接受帮助为代价。
items.en: Receiving help should not cost someone their dignity.
answers: Receiving help should not cost someone their dignity.
Receiving help shouldn't cost someone their dignity.

items.zh: 请不要在公开场合讨论个案。
items.en: Please do not discuss individual cases in public.
answers: Please do not discuss individual cases in public.
Please don't discuss individual cases in public.

items.zh: 我需要了解保密规则。
items.en: I need to understand the confidentiality rules.
answers: I need to understand the confidentiality rules.

items.zh: 我们提供信息，但不替别人决定。
items.en: We offer information without deciding for others.
answers: We offer information without deciding for others.

items.zh: 拒绝参与不应影响其他服务。
items.en: Declining participation should not affect other services.
answers: Declining participation should not affect other services.
Declining participation shouldn't affect other services.

items.zh: 受助者的意见需要认真记录。
items.en: Recipients' views need careful recording.
answers: Recipients' views need careful recording.

items.zh: 关系熟悉也不能忽略边界。
items.en: Familiarity does not remove boundaries.
answers: Familiarity does not remove boundaries.
Familiarity doesn't remove boundaries.

items.zh: 公共花园需要一份维护轮值表。
items.en: The shared garden needs a maintenance rota.
answers: The shared garden needs a maintenance rota.

items.zh: 有人提出增加垃圾桶。
items.en: Someone proposed additional bins.
answers: Someone proposed additional bins.

items.zh: 这项安排影响整个楼栋。
items.en: This arrangement affects the whole building.
answers: This arrangement affects the whole building.

items.zh: 我们需要通知没有加入群聊的人。
items.en: We need to inform people outside the group chat.
answers: We need to inform people outside the group chat.

items.zh: 会议记录可以张贴在公告栏。
items.en: The minutes can go on the noticeboard.
answers: The minutes can go on the noticeboard.

items.zh: 投票前先说明所有选项。
items.en: Explain every option before the vote.
answers: Explain every option before the vote.

items.zh: 噪声记录应包括时间与持续长度。
items.en: Noise records should include timing and duration.
answers: Noise records should include timing and duration.

items.zh: 邻里争议需要双方都有机会说话。
items.en: Neighbour disputes need both sides to be heard.
answers: Neighbour disputes need both sides to be heard.

items.zh: 我们轮流负责给公共活动室锁门吧，免得总由一个邻居承担。
items.en: Let's rotate responsibility for locking the shared room so it does not fall to one neighbour.
answers: Let's rotate responsibility for locking the shared room so it does not fall to one neighbour.
Let's rotate responsibility for locking the shared room so it doesn't fall to one neighbour.
items.notes: rotate responsibility：轮流负责；fall to：由某人承担。

items.zh: 没人回应不代表大家都同意。
items.en: No response does not mean universal agreement.
answers: No response does not mean universal agreement.
No response doesn't mean universal agreement.

items.zh: 筹款目标需要清楚说明。
items.en: The fundraising goal needs a clear explanation.
answers: The fundraising goal needs a clear explanation.

items.zh: 我们应公开资金的具体用途。
items.en: We should disclose how funds will be used.
answers: We should disclose how funds will be used.

items.zh: 捐款人可以选择不署名。
items.en: Donors can choose anonymity.
answers: Donors can choose anonymity.

items.zh: 手续费会减少实际收到的金额。
items.en: Processing fees reduce the amount received.
answers: Processing fees reduce the amount received.

items.zh: 这笔钱限定用于指定项目。
items.en: This money is restricted to a designated project.
answers: This money is restricted to a designated project.

items.zh: 我们需要保存收支凭证。
items.en: We need evidence of income and expenditure.
answers: We need evidence of income and expenditure.

items.zh: 捐款不是购买服务。
items.en: A donation is not a service purchase.
answers: A donation is not a service purchase.
A donation isn't a service purchase.

items.zh: 活动成本也应列在报告里。
items.en: Event costs belong in the report too.
answers: Event costs belong in the report too.

items.zh: 超额募集的资金将如何处理？
items.en: How will surplus funds be handled?
answers: How will surplus funds be handled?

items.zh: 我们会向支持者反馈结果。
items.en: We will report outcomes to supporters.
answers: We will report outcomes to supporters.

items.zh: 参加人数不能说明所有成效。
items.en: Attendance figures do not capture every benefit.
answers: Attendance figures do not capture every benefit.
Attendance figures don't capture every benefit.

items.zh: 最需要服务的人可能没有到场。
items.en: Those most in need may not have attended.
answers: Those most in need may not have attended.

items.zh: 我们需要了解缺席的原因。
items.en: We need to understand the reasons for absence.
answers: We need to understand the reasons for absence.

items.zh: 志愿者也需要休息安排。
items.en: Volunteers need breaks too.
answers: Volunteers need breaks too.

items.zh: 这个流程让登记更公平。
items.en: This process makes registration fairer.
answers: This process makes registration fairer.

items.zh: 反馈应包含不满意的声音。
items.en: Feedback should include dissatisfied voices.
answers: Feedback should include dissatisfied voices.

items.zh: 我们发现了之前忽略的需求。
items.en: We discovered a previously overlooked need.
answers: We discovered a previously overlooked need.

items.zh: 下次需要更早联系场地方。
items.en: Next time we need earlier contact with the venue.
answers: Next time we need earlier contact with the venue.

items.zh: 项目结束后仍要保留求助渠道。
items.en: A support contact should remain after the project.
answers: A support contact should remain after the project.

items.zh: 感谢应覆盖幕后工作的人。
items.en: Thanks should include those working behind the scenes.
answers: Thanks should include those working behind the scenes.
